Gideon's final number for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod was **280 seats**.

He first posted 300 at 09:14, then corrected it at 09:19. The 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout. He confirmed that 280 active seats were on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth replied at 09:21 that the Q3 QBR deck should use the corrected roster.
